admin.title: AI assistant
admin.description: Decide when the assistant keeps customers warm, what it may say, and what it may spend. A person always stays accountable: the AI never acknowledges or owns a lead.
admin.loadFailed: Could not load this page. Try again.

settings.globalOff: AI is switched off for the whole deployment (AI_ENABLED=false). Everything below is saved but has no effect until it is switched on. Lead routing, alerts and escalation work unchanged.
settings.workspaceOff: AI is switched off for this workspace. Customers get your standard replies and your team handles every message.

master.title: AI assistant for this workspace
master.label: Enable the AI assistant
master.helper: Master switch. When off, no AI call is made and every feature falls back to its non-AI version.

standin.title: Stand-in replies
standin.description: While a lead waits for a person, the assistant answers from your knowledge base so the customer is not left on read. Its replies never count as an acknowledgement.

modes.unacked: After a lead has gone unacknowledged for a while
modes.no_handler: Only when nobody on the team is available

standin.secondsHelper: Between 10 and 3600. The timer for the human owner keeps running regardless.
standin.guard: The assistant never quotes prices outside the knowledge base, offers discounts, books, sends payment links or contacts people who opted out.

triage.title: Understanding messages
triage.label: Analyse incoming messages
triage.helper: Detects language, intent and urgency, and summarises voice notes. Angry or urgent customers get a shorter acknowledge window.

voice.title: Voice notes
voice.label: Transcribe voice notes
voice.helper: Customers' WhatsApp voice notes are transcribed, labelled as an AI transcript, and fed into triage. The audio is always kept.

budget.title: Daily budget
budget.capHelper: When the limit is reached the assistant sends a standard reply and summaries pause until tomorrow (Pakistan time).

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.description: The assistant answers only from these entries. If something is not here it says a team member will reply. Prices must appear here to be quoted.

empty.title: No knowledge yet
empty.description: Add your packages, prices, service areas and policies so the assistant can answer common questions.

fields.title: Title
fields.contentHelper: Plain text, up to 2000 characters. Write it as you would tell a customer.

knowledge.confirmDelete: Delete this entry? The assistant will stop using it straight away.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.description: Reusable messages per language. Use '{{'1'}}', '{{'2'}}' for the parts that change. A template with a WhatsApp template name appears in the inbox picker when the 24-hour window is closed.

empty.title: No templates yet
empty.description: Create a message once in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu and reuse it.

fields.keyHelper: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, e.g. follow_up.
fields.waNameHelper: Only if this message is approved in Meta. Leave empty for in-window use.

templates.confirmDelete: Delete this template? Existing conversations are not changed.
templates.conflict: A template with this name and language already exists.

voice.label: AI transcript
voice.failed: Transcription unavailable. The audio is still playable.
voice.failedDisabled: Transcription is switched off. The audio is still playable.
